title: Soul x402 invocation grant
description: A minimized host-issued off-chain grant for one bounded public paid invocation. It is scoped invocation authority only and does not confer principal, operator, wallet, or tenant-data authority. The required access scope is explicit downstream tool vocabulary (`read`, `write`, `admin`) and is intentionally separate from authority. Capability vocabulary is versioned: `scoped-invocation/v1` remains actor/scoped invocation vocabulary, while `instance-capability/v1` is restricted to instance tool capabilities `instance:agent_create` and `instance:install_plan`.

grantToken.description: Raw opaque grant token returned once on first issue. Host stores only sha256(grantToken); idempotent replays intentionally omit it.

capabilityVersion.description: Versioned capability vocabulary. Instance tools must use `instance-capability/v1`; actor/scoped invocation capabilities remain separate under `scoped-invocation/v1`.

capability.description: Capability within `capabilityVersion`. For `instance-capability/v1`, allowed values are `instance:agent_create` and `instance:install_plan`.

tool.description: Concrete downstream tool name. For `instance:agent_create`, use `agent_create`; for `instance:install_plan`, use `agent_local_install_plan` (Host also accepts `install_plan`).

scope.description: Access scope enforced by the consuming runtime before side effects. This is not principal/operator/session authority.

requestHash.description: sha256 hash of the concrete invocation request Body must present later; raw request body is not stored.

callerSubjectHash.description: sha256 hash of the public caller subject. The raw subject is not returned.

facilitatorTrustBoundary.description: The facilitator value is caller-provided payment-binding metadata, not host-verified settlement proof.
